bug_semantics: xxl-job-admin login sets cookie XXL_JOB_LOGIN_IDENTITY from LoginService.makeToken, which JSON-serializes the full XxlJobUser (id, username, unsalted MD5 password, role, permission) and hex-encodes those bytes with BigInteger.toString(16). parseToken inverts the hex, so an intercepted cookie yields the MD5 password and admin identity (issue #3751 PoC). IndexController.loginDo only delegates to LoginService; makeToken is not in IndexController as VulDB claims. Stored passwords are unsalted MD5 (CWE-916) and the cookie encoding is reversible, not encryption (CWE-326).
flaw_origin: The hex-JSON cookie token was first written in 0a3542dcac7b91aca5d3a6e0dd8deb45f41e3dcb (2019-05-04, '用户管理：支持在线维护系统用户') when LoginService.makeToken/parseToken replaced the prior config-user scheme. Parent 69d22f2c78fb90a3a006469749f72fbd8e6a0318 used PermissionInterceptor: MD5(username_'_'+password) then hex of that digest as a static cookie — no user JSON, no reversible credential blob. Later a2dc9011 (rename to service/impl) and 7b23fd2a (javax→jakarta) did not change makeToken. Removed in cb1bd548 by xxl-sso random UUID tokens plus SHA-256 passwords.
